source: new in plan 095 (2026-10-12): six sites turn a float into cents, each spelled differently - int(x * 100), int(round(x, 2) * 100), int(x*100) with no spaces, math.floor(100 * x), round(x * 100) (half-even, so it looks rounded), and a %d format that truncates - and the visible suite covers only the invoice line
hard_because: Fixing the `int(... * 100)` sites a grep finds (invoice, tax, shipping) turns the suite green; check_cents also runs refund_cents (math.floor(100 * x)), deposit_cents (round, half-even on 62.5) and receipt_line (a truncating %d) on values where they land a cent off.
